resources.string: Moves the fake position by detected real walking steps using the accelerometer and magnetometer. It never replaces the fake anchor with your real GPS coordinates.
Uses a partial wake lock while spoofing. This can improve persistence with the screen off, but increases battery use.
This screen reports what this build can control. It does not guarantee that every app sees only the fake location.
Mock-location paths controlled by this build
Still real / not globally spoofed without root or system privileges

• Wi‑Fi scan environment / BSSIDs
• Cellular towers / CellInfo
• Bluetooth scan environment
• Raw GNSS measurements / NMEA
• IP-based geolocation
Android may still mark these Location objects as mock. This build does not try to hide that marker.
